text:
raj_support: FYI ACME corp is blocked on onboarding. SCIM JIT provisioning fails when SAML response includes 'groups' claim. Customer sees user not created + audit shows 403 decrypt from KMS. Need triage. Repro steps below.

lena_identity: can you paste the exact SAML attribute mapping and the error log lines? also which tenant + SCIM client id?

raj_support: tenant=acme-prod, scim_client=svc-scim-acme. SAML snippet: 
```xml
<Attribute Name="groups">
  <AttributeValue>engineering</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
```
Error from provisioning service (truncated):
```
2026-02-24T15:02:09Z ERROR provisioner: decrypt token failed: status=403, body={"error":"access_denied","detail":"decrypt failed: key_version_mismatch"}
```
We get same behavior when replaying SAML -> our SCIM flow calls /internal/provision and that call returns 403.

marcus_sre: quick checklist: 1) confirm KMS key in tenant metadata 2) check HSM audit for decrypt attempts 3) confirm service principal role has kms:Decrypt.

olivia_security: any recent key rotations on that tenant? key_version_mismatch implies the service used an old key id. who manages key rotation for acme-prod?

raj_support: customer says they rotated keys last week via their KMS. But our config should reference key_id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd. I ran curl repro: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/provision \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer svc-token' \
  -d '{"saml_response":"<...>","client_id":"svc-scim-acme"}' -v
# response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
# {"error":"decrypt failed","code":"KMS_403","request_id":"req-9a12"}
```

lena_identity: can you fetch the audit line id for that request? run `redwoodctl audit tail --tenant acme-prod --filter request_id=req-9a12` and paste the entry.

raj_support: did that, entry id audit-20260224-7, payload: action=decrypt, principal=svc-scim-acme, key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd, status=DENIED, reason=KeyVersionMismatch.

marcus_sre: sounds like RBAC on our side: the SCIM service principal might be scoped to an old key alias/version. I can create a canary role with kms:Decrypt on the live key to test. Proceeding to assign temporarily.

inc-bot: [automated] Incident created INC-2026-45: "acme-prod provisioning blocked (KMS decrypt 403)" by raj_support at 2026-02-24T15:06:00Z

olivia_security: also need to confirm audit retention and export settings for acme-prod for compliance. default retention is 365d but they may have custom retention/export to their SIEM. raj, please confirm whether their onboarding expects logs to be forwarded to their S3/Syslog.

raj_support: ACME asked for 7y retention in contract, they *do* forward steam to their S3 bucket (s3://acme-audit). I see the export pipeline healthy. This is about decryption flow only.

marcus_sre: canary role deployed, repro again -> provision call now returns 200 and user is created. So root cause: svc-scim-acme role lacked permission on new key version. I've posted canary role diff: 
```json
{"Role":"svc-scim-acme","Policy": ["kms:Decrypt":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd"]}
```

lena_identity: for least-privilege review: the SCIM principal only needs kms:Decrypt on the specific key alias used for provisioning tokens, not kms:* or broad key ARNs. Also ensure scope excludes customer data keys.

olivia_security: action items: 1) update tenant RBAC to include new key id for svc-scim-acme (marcus) 2) verify key rotation process updates RBAC (ops) 3) document fallback: enable JIT fallback to SCIM-sync until rotation completes (identity).

raj_support: temp mitigation for customer: set env var PROVISION_JIT_FALLBACK=true on acme-prod which will skip encrypted-token path and use signed SAML assertion -> will unblock while we fix RBAC. Command: `redwoodctl tenant set acme-prod --env PROVISION_JIT_FALLBACK=true`

marcus_sre: done. I also added an audit annotation: audit-20260224-7 -> action=rbac-patch, actor=marcus_sre, note="granted decrypt on new key version for svc-scim-acme".

olivia_security: please add a short postmortem entry in INC-2026-45 with root cause = key rotation + RBAC drift, impact = onboarding blocked, mitigation = granted decrypt + JIT fallback, follow-ups = automate RBAC update on key rotation, confirm with customer.

raj_support: will follow up with ACME (PTR opened) and close once they confirm repro. thx everyone :thumbsup:

lena_identity: suggest we also add a lint to our provisioning pipeline that validates KMS key versions referenced by tenant metadata at rotation time. filing task.
